answer: Each agent’s reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, verified honest service rather than briefly accumulated. In the EigenTrust factorization, a freshly spawned sybil has no trusted incoming endorsements and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unsupported links enough to pass consensus. A canyon of time, not a marble token or spiral of aliases, separates durable trust from fabricated identity.
